producer_consumer.consumer: SGLang LogitsProcessor._get_logits -> _compute_lm_head -> monotone final softcap(30) -> target verifier or sampler

embedding_structure.token_frequency_evidence: No persisted campaign token-frequency or target-verifier token-ID distribution was found; frequency-aware routing was not simulated.

candidate.representation: Exactly balanced hierarchical 2-means over fixed Gaussian projections of the tied token embeddings; exact original-space centroids and exact candidate token dot products.
candidate.sampling_support: Not implemented. Candidate-only scoring does not preserve full-distribution OpenRouter sampling.

fixture_finding.fallback: Two deterministic 32-row synthetic structural proxies at the captured hidden-state norm: four-embedding mixtures and isotropic directions.

results.verifier_decision_metric: Per-position target decision recall equals top-1 recall because the final softcap is monotone; accepted-prefix recall was not measured without draft token IDs and request/depth mapping.

grouped_exact_ideal_reuse.evidence: Analytical floor; independent grouped project is compiled but has not executed.

retrieval.limiter_at_useful_recall: Candidate-cluster weight traffic grows before the tested index reaches acceptable recall.
retrieval.maximum_whole_request_opportunity: The measured dense head is only 5.2487% of the profile window; no tested recall-valid retrieval row earns a transfer estimate.

interpretation.decision: The tested training-free balanced centroid mechanism is not a credible competitor to the exact grouped lane. Increasing projection width from 32 to 128 does not repair the recall/cost frontier.
interpretation.limiter: routing recall first, then candidate-cluster HBM traffic at high probe counts
interpretation.not_concluded: This does not falsify learned FlashHead routing, selective quantization, frequency-aware clustering, post-training, model quality, or sampling.

minimum_next_experiment.capture: One unseen full target-verification step: 384 post-final-norm BF16 hidden rows, 384 proposed draft token IDs, dense top-10 IDs and values, request/depth mapping, and dense accepted-prefix decisions.
minimum_next_experiment.gate: Do not open a GPU component for this static index. Resume only if a learned or frequency-aware router produces at least 31/32 per-position top-1 and 90% top-10 recall offline while its H200 model remains below the 1093.817 us grouped-exact floor.
